composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: A copper-bodied dragonfly rests across the curled rim of a lotus leaf, centered within a square close-up. The leaf bends behind the insect like a shallow natural window, leaving a dark teal opening that separates the transparent wings from the background. Render the wing membranes with fine branching veins, a few tiny droplets, and restrained pale gold reflections. Use broad blue-green leaf planes so the delicate anatomy remains the focal point. The dragonfly is viewed slightly from above, with all four wings clearly distinct. Include only a sliver of still water below. Avoid a busy pond scene; the composition should balance detailed wings with large calm areas of leaf and shadow.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
